mods.name: Session Timer
mods.description: A configurable session HUD timer for comparing item pickup priority.

releases.notes:
Fabric API and compatibility cleanup.

- Keeps one JAR for Minecraft 1.21.8 and newer
- Isolates the unavoidable Minecraft 1.21.11 keybinding ABI bridge
- Uses Fabric Loader MappingResolver instead of hardcoded runtime mapping probes
- Continues to use Fabric lifecycle, networking, keybinding, and HUD APIs

Requires Fabric Loader, Fabric API, and Java 21.

SHA-256: FC9A213D73C9A51EF9707724F8BAAC976BE27808C51E8B9CDC0223835A8869FA

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Flarrencjusz/Session-Timer/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2

mods.name: Session Timer
mods.description: A configurable session HUD timer for comparing item pickup priority.

releases.notes:
First public release of Session Timer.

- Client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.8 and newer
- Automatic timer restart on server switch
- Draggable and configurable HUD
- Compatible with the Minecraft 1.21.11 keybinding and input API changes

Requires Fabric Loader, Fabric API, and Java 21.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Flarrencjusz/Session-Timer/commits/v1.0.1

readmeSummary: A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.8 and newer. It displays the time elapsed since joining the current server, making it easier to compare session age when investigating item pickup...
